purpose: Teach: グローバリゼーション/投信/空母/プレーオフ/有線/セメント/プランニング/農水省
target_vocab: グローバリゼーション

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、グローバリゼーションで国際犯罪が増えますね
lines.en: So with globalization, police deal with more international crime, don't they?
lines.style: Conversational, curious tone. Leans forward slightly with genuine interest. Warm and collaborative—drawing someone into sharing expertise, not interrogating.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、投信詐欺事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: And investment fraud cases too—that's part of what the police handle, right?
lines.style: Same warm curiosity as before. Nodding energy. Picking up on each new area with genuine fascination, like discovering layers of a role.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、海上自衛隊の空母警備も担当されますね
lines.en: I imagine you also cover security for naval vessels and carriers?
lines.style: Still collaborative, but slightly softer—this is a more specialized area. Building the conversation with gentle assurance, not challenge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、プレーオフ時の球場警備もされますね
lines.en: And stadium security during playoffs—that must be yours too?
lines.style: Warm and easy. The questions keep building naturally, like pieces clicking into place. No strain, just genuine interest in the breadth of the work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、有線通信の傍受技術もお持ちですね
lines.en: You have expertise in wiretap surveillance technology as well, I'd imagine?
lines.style: Same warm rhythm, but now with a slight acknowledgment of technical sophistication. Respectful of the skill involved. Still collaborative, not hierarchical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、セメント詰めの遺体事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: Cases involving remains—cement disposal cases, for instance—those come to you too?
lines.style: Tone stays warm but registers a subtle shift to the gravity of the subject. Still respectful and collaborative. The questions don't flinch.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査プランニングもされますね
lines.en: So investigative planning falls under the police's work as well?
lines.style: Continuing the natural rhythm of discovery. Each piece adding to the picture. Still warm and collaborative, drawing out the full scope of the role.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、農水省関連の食品偽装も扱われますね
lines.en: And food fraud cases connected to the agricultural ministry—that's in your wheelhouse too?
lines.style: Tone shifts slightly warmer, more familiar. The questions have built genuine rapport. This final one lands as the natural conclusion of understanding someone's breadth of work.
